findings.title: A dateUpdated backfill can overwrite the current modification date
findings.description: When a document is missing both a fixable field (for example, `status`) and `dateUpdated`, the status fix first stamps `dateUpdated` with the current date. The precomputed `dateUpdated` finding is then processed and writes `dateCreated` over that stamp. This leaves a document that was modified by `--fix` with a stale update date. Preserve the backfill behavior for a date-only fix, but avoid letting it overwrite the stamp after other fixes have modified the file.

findings.title: --fix can write through a symlink outside the project
findings.description: The `--fix` loop writes to each finding’s `filePath`. The validator’s in-root check in `packages/core/src/schema/frontmatterFileValidator.ts:52-63` is lexical and does not resolve symlinks; the default directory walk can also return symlinked `.md` files. A symlink under the document root that targets a file outside it can therefore be validated and, with `--fix`, modified outside the project. Resolve and verify the target’s real path before applying writes.
